diagnostics.name: not-sendable-spawn
notes: the spawned callee is a closure: closures capture their environment, so spawning one shares every capture with the new task (A5) — spawn a declared top-level `fn` instead

if the closure is the design (an actor loop, a worker body), wrap the site in `managed("why this bypass is safe", "actor") { ... }` — the explicit, auditable hatch (HYB-E8001, counted by --report-managed)
